logic_node.action: Refer to multidisciplinary HF disease management program
logic_node.action_detail: In patients with high-risk HF, particularly those with recurrent hospitalizations for HFrEF, referral to multidisciplinary HF disease management programs is recommended to reduce the risk of hospitalization. Programs may include cardiologists, primary care clinicians, HF nurses, pharmacists, dieticians, social workers, and community health workers.

source_text: In patients with high-risk HF, particularly those with recurrent hospitalizations for HFrEF, referral to multidisciplinary HF disease management programs is recommended to reduce the risk of hospitalization.

logic_node.action: Provide patient-centered discharge instructions with transitional care plan
logic_node.action_detail: In patients hospitalized with worsening HF, patient-centered discharge instructions with a clear plan for transitional care should be provided before hospital discharge. Instructions should address activity level, diet, discharge medications, follow-up appointment, weight monitoring, cardiac rehabilitation, and what to do if symptoms worsen.

source_text: In patients hospitalized with worsening HF, patient-centered discharge instructions with a clear plan for transitional care should be provided before hospital discharge.

logic_node.action: Participate in systems allowing benchmarking to performance measures
logic_node.action_detail: In patients hospitalized with worsening HF, participation in systems that allow benchmarking to performance measures is reasonable to increase use of evidence-based therapy and improve quality of care. Electronic point-of-care reminders to prescribe GDMT in patients with HFrEF can improve use.

source_text: In patients hospitalized with worsening HF, participation in systems that allow benchmarking to performance measures is reasonable to increase use of evidence-based therapy, and to improve quality of care.

logic_node.action: Schedule early follow-up within 7 days of hospital discharge
logic_node.action_detail: In patients being discharged after hospitalization for worsening HF, an early follow-up, generally within 7 days of hospital discharge, is reasonable to optimize care and reduce rehospitalization. The timing and method of delivery (in-person clinic versus virtual visit by video or telephone) should be individualized based on patient risk and available care delivery options.

source_text: In patients being discharged after hospitalization for worsening HF, an early follow-up, generally within 7 days of hospital discharge, is reasonable to optimize care and reduce rehospitalization.

logic_node.action: Adjust diuretics based on volume status and electrolytes at discharge
logic_node.action_detail: A transitional care plan should include adjusting diuretics based on volume status (including weight) and electrolytes, and coordination of safety laboratory checks (e.g., electrolytes after initiation or intensification of GDMT).

source_text: Adjusting diuretics based on volume status (including weight) and electrolytes; Coordination of safety laboratory checks (eg, electrolytes after initiation or intensification of GDMT)

logic_node.action: Plan GDMT optimization at discharge including resumption, initiation, and titration
logic_node.action_detail: A transitional care plan should include plans for resuming medications held in the hospital, plans for initiating new medications, and plans for titration of GDMT to goal doses as tolerated.

source_text: Further changes to optimize GDMT, including: Plans for resuming medications held in the hospital; Plans for initiating new medications; Plans for titration of GDMT to goal doses as tolerated

logic_node.action: Consider referral to palliative care or hospice enrollment at discharge
logic_node.action_detail: A transitional care plan should include referral to palliative care specialists and/or enrollment in hospice in selected patients, as well as additional surgical or device therapy and referral to cardiac rehabilitation where appropriate.

source_text: Additional surgical or device therapy, referral to cardiac rehabilitation in the future, where appropriate; Referral to palliative care specialists and/or enrollment in hospice in selected patients.

logic_node.action: Address comorbid conditions and psychosocial factors in transitional care
logic_node.action_detail: A transitional care plan should address high-risk characteristics associated with poor postdischarge outcomes including: comorbid conditions (renal dysfunction, pulmonary disease, diabetes, mental health, substance use disorders), limitations in psychosocial support, and impaired health literacy or cognitive impairment.

source_text: Addressing high-risk characteristics that may be associated with poor postdischarge clinical outcomes, such as: Comorbid conditions (eg, renal dysfunction, pulmonary disease, diabetes, mental health, and substance use disorders)
